item.title: When Listening Becomes Another Way to Lecture
item.description: Interviews with 20 illicit tobacco users in New Zealand reveal how financial hardship, nicotine dependence and frustration with tobacco policies influence purchasing decisions. (Published on October 29, 2026bysubstack.com)

item.title: Cigarettes are losing importance. Data show a clear shift among young people
item.description: Norway's latest figures reveal a significant generational shift in nicotine use. Daily smoking has fallen to just 6% of the population, while 15% now use snus, making it more than twice as common as cigarettes. (Published on October 29, 2026bymojanorwegia.pl)
